issues.location: Products with 50+ reviews convert at 2-3x the rate of products without reviews (Bazaarvoice / Spiegel Research Center).
issues.explanation: This is a debunked benchmark. Spiegel Research Center found that 5 reviews (not 50+) produced a 270% conversion uplift. The '50+ reviews at 2-3x' figure is a misrepresentation of the actual study and is flagged as a fabricated benchmark regardless of attribution.

issues.location: Average AOV uplift with cross-sell is 8-15% (Baymard Institute).
issues.explanation: Baymard Institute never published an 8-15% AOV uplift figure for cross-sell. This is a fabricated benchmark attributed to Baymard, which is a debunked stat on the watch list.

issues.location: A screenshot of the H&M Colombia homepage was captured during the audit but was served from a local rendering pipeline and could not be verified as showing the live site rather than a WAF/bot-protection interstitial. It has been omitted from this report.
issues.explanation: The report explicitly acknowledges that captured screenshots may show WAF/bot-protection interstitials rather than real site content. While the screenshots were correctly omitted, this note appears three times and confirms the WAF_SCREENSHOT risk was encountered. The omission is handled appropriately, but the issue is worth flagging as it affected audit data collection.

issues.location: local competitors like Studio F, Adrissa, NAF NAF, SevenSeven
issues.explanation: NAF NAF is a brand that has had ownership connections to H&M Group in certain markets. If NAF NAF is owned or co-owned by H&M Group in the Colombian market context, listing it as a competitor would be a sister-brand error. This should be verified; if NAF NAF Colombia is not under H&M Group ownership, this may be a false positive, but it warrants flagging for review.

summary: The report contains two confirmed high-severity fabricated benchmarks (Spiegel '50+ reviews' misquote and Baymard cross-sell AOV claim), a WAF screenshot issue that was disclosed and mitigated but still affected audit integrity, and a potential sister-brand competitor listing (NAF NAF) that requires ownership verification; all other checks passed cleanly.
